ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% low-intensity (black) to 15% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity bands are visible along the trailing edges of both lobes, transitioning into high-frequency black mottling toward the interior; the central and leading regions are dominated by solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with sharp pixel-amplitude peaks and irregular valleys spanning the entire trailing edge boundary from the lateral tips to the median notch region.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curvature on the distal halves of the lobes, transitioning to a slight concavity as the contour approaches the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of high-contrast, multi-tonal (white, tan, and pink) circular pixel aggregates concentrated on the distal tips of both lobes and intermittently along the trailing margins.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, vertical, high-intensity linear disruptions are visible on the right lobe (viewer perspective), originating from the mid-fluke area and extending toward the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive colonization of calcified organisms (barnacles) creating significant structural protrusions at the lateral termini of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Water turbulence and spray occlude the peduncle attachment point and the vertex of the median notch.
